approved.en: Russia is intensifying airstrikes on Ukrainian energy sites, including power plants in Kyiv and civilian areas in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries and hit a Russian Iskander-M missile maintenance base. Ukraine also reported hitting six Russian Su-34 bomber jets with a Neptune missile and accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink terminals used for drone operations. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges and announced a diesel deal framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine rejected as false. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland intensiverer luftangrep på ukrainske energianlegg, inkludert kraftverk i Kyiv og sivile områder i Zaporizhzhia, mens Ukraina har gjenopptatt angrep på russiske oljeraffinerier og rammet en russisk Iskander-M missilvedlikeholdsbase. Ukraina rapporterte også å ha truffet seks russiske Su‑34 bombefly med en Neptune-missil og anklaget SpaceX for å dempe Starlink-terminaler som brukes til droneoperasjoner. Russiske myndigheter har fengslet en japansk journalist på spionasjebeskyldning og kunngjort en dieseldel som er fremstilt som en energivåpenhvile, noe Ukraina avviste som falskt. 75 767 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Iran saw two container ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz amid a surge in Iranian attacks, linking regional tension to the Gaza conflict. Gaza’s raw sewage is now flooding the Mediterranean as Israel restricts reconstruction, and art projects are linking Gaza and the West Bank. 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Gazas råavløp flommer nå inn i Middelhavet ettersom Israel begrenser gjenoppbygging, og kunstprosjekter knytter Gaza og Vestbredden sammen. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.
approved.nb: Hezbollah-eksplosiver som ble beslaglagt i to libanesiske lastebiler har fått Libanons statsminister og sikkerhetsstyrker til å love en grundig etterforskning, mens israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i sørlige Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

approved.en: The Houthis have stepped up attacks on Saudi Arabia, attempting strikes on dozens of Saudi facilities and launching missiles that killed two ministers at Yemen's presidential palace in Aden, while Saudi-led coalition forces intercepted missiles and said they repelled further Houthi attempts. In Yemen, fighting around Taiz threatens civilian lifelines and aid deliveries, and Houthi threats to hit Saudi targets again have rattled Gulf markets. The group also denied targeting the holy city of Medina after Saudi claims of an intercepted missile. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian security forces arrested the main suspect in the 2013 Baniyas massacre and sentenced two individuals to death for the 2025 coastal sectarian violence, while another pair received death sentences for related clashes. A gas export pipeline in northeastern Syria was attacked, causing a fire, and Syrian intelligence detained a militia leader linked to the 2013 Baniyas massacre. Qatar and Syria’s interior ministries deepened security cooperation in Damascus, and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu disclosed direct contact with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa regarding the Druze community. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En gasseksportpipeline i nordøstlige Syria ble angrepet, noe som førte til brann, og syrisk etterretning fengslet en militsleder knyttet til Baniyas-massakren i 2013. Qatar og Syriens innenriksdepartement styrket sikkerhetssamarbeidet i Damaskus, og Israels statsminister Netanyahu opplyste om direkte kontakt med Syriens president Ahmed al-Sharaa angående drus-samfunnet. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi authorities are publicly pledging to prevent the use of Iraqi territory for attacks on Saudi Arabia, while the pro-Iran militia Kataib Hezbollah warned it will target any hostile aircraft over Iraq and a rival armed group said a weapons agreement with Iran remains stalled. Iraq’s Supreme Court declared the Kurdistan Region security law unconstitutional and US firms are assessing air-defence investment in the Kurdistan Region. Human-trafficking networks were dismantled, rescuing newborns, and a weapons and explosives cache was seized in Baghdad’s Husseiniya district. The Iraqi MP warned that a ban on the Waze navigation app could disrupt delivery services. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iraks høyesterett erklærte sikkerhetsloven i Kurdistan-regionen grunnlovsstridig, og amerikanske firmaer vurderer investeringer i luftvern i Kurdistan-regionen. Menneskehandelsnettverk ble oppløst, nyfødte ble reddet, og en våpen‑ og sprengstofflager ble beslaglagt i Husseiniya-distriktet i Bagdad. approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces launched air strikes on gold mining sites near the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners, while the Rapid Support Forces used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, adding civilian casualties in West Kordofan. In the Blue Nile, the Sudanese army repelled a joint RSF and SPLM-N attack, inflicting heavy losses on the attackers. Drought, war and climate-related drone attacks are worsening the humanitarian crisis and raising the risk of famine across Darfur, Kordofan and other regions. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Blue Nile avviste hæren et felles angrep fra RSF og SPLM-N, og påførte angriperne store tap. Tørke, krig og klima-relaterte droneangrep forverrer den humanitære krisen og øker risikoen for hungersnød i Darfur, Kordofan og andre regioner. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

UNMISS has increased civilian protection efforts after deadly attacks in Rumbek, while SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an assault on a Mundri West military outpost and the U.S. Embassy condemned an assault on WFP workers in Jonglei that involved looting of aid. An AIC cleric was shot dead in Juba and a Juba High Court sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The United States has stepped up diplomatic pressure and called for de-escalation as the conflict spreads. Leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan and Somalia are meeting to coordinate security operations if the fighting crosses borders. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ledere fra Egypt, Eritrea, Sudan og Somalia møtes for å koordinere sikkerhetsoperasjoner dersom kampene krysser grenser. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharin forces are consolidating control of the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces claim to have captured Buurhakaba after heavy fighting in the Bay region, and fighters loyal to a former regional president have also seized Burhakaba. The Somali government is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid rising Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. The federal government is deepening defence ties with Pakistan, seeking JF‑17 fighter jets and securing the release of four Pakistani sailors freed from Somali pirates. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den somaliske regjeringen screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og den er vert for regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten midt i økende spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Den føderale regjeringen utdyper forsvarssamarbeidet med Pakistan, søker JF‑17‑jagerfly og sikrer løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra somaliske pirater. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen attacked an immigration patrol in Niger State, killing one officer and wounding another, and also burned the officer's body. Bandits carried out a separate assault in Borgu LGA, while a Christian humanitarian worker was slain in northwest Nigeria and a Niger lawyer was jailed for a social-media post about the army. The United States added Nigeria to its blacklist for recruiting child soldiers, and Mali expanded its reserve force by 2,400 recruits, including 800 women. These incidents show a widening of violence beyond isolated attacks on security forces to include civilian targets and legal repression. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
